decisions.name: December 2024 MAHL report and March 2025 EGLE review package
decisions.reason: Retained as materially distinct records. The 204-page March package contains an agency-review email, a revised January 2025 report and supporting material; 122 of its normalized pages match pages in the standalone 131-page December report, and pages 101-148 repeat internally as pages 153-200. Exact master copies found under the Duplicates folder were not republished. Image-only O&M excerpts were visually verified; the March package's final four pages are blank.
